The claim accurately reflects the guideline's description of TPE etiology, including the 6-12 week timeframe and specific triggers for reactivation.
The claim correctly identifies the post-primary nature and later mean age of TPE in industrialized countries as stated in the quote.
The claim faithfully reproduces the pathogenic mechanism described in the guideline, including the sequence of inflammatory cells and lymphatic obstruction.
The claim accurately reflects the guideline's description of Th1 infiltration and its consequences for bacterial load and culture yield in TPE.
The claim correctly identifies the appearance, exudate classification, and specific lymphocyte percentage thresholds (>50% and >75%) as stated in the quote.
The claim correctly captures the timing of neutrophil predominance (early/empyema) and the shift to lymphocyte predominance after approximately two weeks.
The claim accurately reflects the guideline's description of uncomplicated TPE fluid characteristics, including the pH threshold and protein/LDH levels.

The claim correctly distinguishes between high-prevalence and low-prevalence settings and matches the recommended actions for each scenario.
The claim accurately reflects the guideline's statement that a lymphocyte-to-neutrophil ratio greater than 0.75 enhances specificity in cases of false-positive ADA.

The claim correctly identifies the 65% progression rate within two years and the resulting importance of early diagnosis and treatment as stated in the quote.
The claim accurately reflects the pathophysiology and diagnostic yields (5-10% smear, 30-50% culture) stated in the guideline quote.
